Name: Froststar11's Neat Greenhouse
Author: froststar11
Description:
Hi there! This is my very first mod! I'm very excited to share it with you.

I got tired of greenhouse mods that were either unorganized or far too large and game-breaking, so I found a happy medium!

LAYOUT:
This greenhouse layout has space for 2 of each fruit tree, six 5x5 areas that are sprinkler friendly (divided in half so you can grow multiple things), and four 3x3 sprinkler friendly areas that I use for the Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter seed sets to grow foraging items, but that you can use for anything you'd like! I added a second water source since I enlarged the greenhouse, and running all the way across to the back corner would have gotten annoying quickly. 

I also tried to find a balance with the decor; enough that it's aesthetically pleasing, but not so much that it gets in the way. Most of the decor is along the back wall. The sides have been left clear so you can add kegs or other artisan machines. I also left some gaps in the back wall area. I placed garden pots there in sets of three with each trellis crop. I like the way it looks against the greenhouse walls!

If there's enough interest, I can easily add a version of this greenhouse with no decor. 

Right now, this mod is ONLY available as a .xnb file, and you'll need to replace the original file in the game folder to use it. I'm working on learning how to utilize content patcher and SMAPI to make the replacement unnecessary. 

HOW TO INSTALL:
- Download the provided zip file.
- Extract the contents of the file.
- Copy the file (Greenhouse.xnb). 
- Paste it into your game folder under StardewValley\Content\Maps.
- When prompted, replace the original Greenhouse file with the new one. 

NOTE: Since you are going to have to replace the original game file, make sure you have saved a copy of it somewhere as a backup!

HOW TO UNINSTALL:
- Go to the game folder and find the file called "Greenhouse.xnb"
- Delete the file. 
- Copy the backup of the original file that came with the game and paste it back into the Maps folder to restore the original greenhouse layout.
